description: Points an existing automation back at an earlier version, named by its number (to_version). No version changes; if the automation is switched on, it runs that version from then on. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it rolls back. Returns the automation.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

name: rollback_automation
title: Roll an automation back
